title: Baseline Year and Rainfall Affect Apparent Greening in Community-Managed Social Forestry Areas: A Sentinel Case Study from Southern Malang, Indonesia
description: Analysis code and derived result tables for a Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 matched comparison of three social forestry permit areas in southern Malang, Indonesia, against a regional forest-estate benchmark (annual series 2017-2025, NASA POWER rainfall). Permit boundary polygons are provided by Balai Perhutanan Sosial Yogyakarta and are not included.
